sourceRows.zh: adv.极端 极其 非常

sourceRows.zh: n.视力 目力

sourceRows.zh: n.失败 失败的人或事

sourceRows.zh: adj.最后的 决定性的 n.决赛 期末考试

senses.zh: adv.最后 最终 不可更改的

ex.en: Finally, diversifying our diet away from heat-sensitive wheat, corn, rice and other crops could also help.
Finally, the FBI received a tip that the stolen document was located very close to Washington, D.C.

tip: 表示终于常置于实义动词前；引出最后一点常置句首。

sourceRows.zh: adv.最后 最终 不可更改的

senses.zh: n.财政 金融 财源 vt.给...提供资金 负担经费

ex.en: In a study, psychologist Myriam Bechtoldt of the Frankfurt School of Finance and Management in Germany asked 166 male university students a series of questions to measure their emotional intelligence.
In her experience, people in positions of power or people in finance or engineering do not tend to like the sound of the word.

col: finance a project｜为项目提供资金
tip: finance可指资金或金融；个人财务常用finances。

sourceRows.zh: n.财政 金融 财源 vt.给...提供资金 负担经费

senses.zh: adj.财政的 金融的

ex.en: I felt that I was sailing the financial seas with no skills and no life jacket!
My financial aid did not anticipate any of these costs, and so it did not cover them.

col: financial stability｜金融稳定；财务稳定
tip: financial侧重金钱与财务；economic侧重经济整体。

sourceRows.zh: adj.财政的 金融的

senses.zh: vt. & vi.找到 发觉 找出 感觉到 认为 n.发现物

ex.en: There are tools to compare one's DNA with others' to find distant relatives based on their genetic identification.
The Harvard study examined seven years of school results data and could not find any impact from snow closures.

col: find a solution｜找到解决办法
find it difficult to｜觉得做某事困难
a valuable find｜有价值的发现物
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为found；find＋宾语＋形容词。

sourceRows.zh: vt. & vi.找到 发觉 找出 感觉到 认为 n.发现物

senses.zh: n. 发现 发现物 调查(或研究)的结果 [律] 裁判 裁决 (复数）findings：(珠宝商等使用的)零碎的工具或材料 find的现在分词

ex.en: After finding out details about a stranger, we mistakenly think that they also know about us.
Of course, finding that balance probably shouldn't be something you have to do by yourself.

col: publish the findings｜公布调查结果
a finding of fact｜事实认定
tip: 表示研究或调查结果时，常用复数findings。

sourceRows.zh: n. 发现 发现物 调查(或研究)的结果 [律] 裁判 裁决 (复数）findings：(珠宝商等使用的)零碎的工具或材料 find的现在分词

senses.zh: a. 美好的 优质的 精致的 晴朗的 健康的 纤细的 恭维的 辞藻华丽的 adv. 恰好地 合适地 n. 罚款 罚金 结尾 vt. 罚款 vi. 净化 细化

ex.en: Even if your groom is fine with it, his family (or your own) might not be so understanding.
The fine dining establishment received its first three-star Michelin rating in 2011 when the menu was famed for its fancy animal-based dishes.

tip: fine作动词也指罚款：fine sb for sth。

sourceRows.zh: a. 美好的 优质的 精致的 晴朗的 健康的 纤细的 恭维的 辞藻华丽的 adv. 恰好地 合适地 n. 罚款 罚金 结尾 vt. 罚款 vi. 净化 细化

senses.zh: n.手指 指针 指状物 vt.用手指触碰(演奏) (用手)指 vi.触摸用手指演奏乐器

ex.en: During the meal, the man's wedding ring slipped off his finger.
Instead of digging through pieces of paper and peering into corners, we move our fingers left and right.

col: point a finger at｜用手指指向；指责
tip: 通常不包括拇指；拇指专称thumb。

sourceRows.zh: n.手指 指针 指状物 vt.用手指触碰(演奏) (用手)指 vi.触摸用手指演奏乐器

ex.en: When reporter Joan Solsman, a longtime vegetarian, tried a dish from Impossible Foods, she felt so sick that she couldn't finish it.
Perhaps the point of writing the flawless essay was not to give up, but to never willingly finish.

tip: 表示做完某事用finish doing，不用finish to do。

sourceRows.zh: vt.完成 结束 获...第几名 vi.终结 完成 n.结束 完成 最后加工 结局 完美

ex.en: For his part, Wang said that in his own experience, losing did light a motivating fire.
We recently caught up with yoga entrepreneur Leah Zaccaria, who put herself through the fire of change to completely reinvent herself.

tip: catch fire指开始着火；be on fire指正在燃烧。
